sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('d9b975bd-e3f4-466e-96ca-7bef7899506d', 'b0dedf95-8395-46bf-b94a-dcf2dd085942') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
